title: Paying to Know: Micro-Transaction Markets for Verified Product Information in Agentic E-Commerce
title_zh: 付费求真：Agentic 电商中用于验证产品信息的微交易市场
abstract_en: Commercial NLP treats the shopping chatbot as a recommender or a conversion tool: its job is to match a user to a catalogue entry and close a sale. We argue that the arrival of agent-native micro-payment rails (e.g., x402, AP2) changes what is scarce. When the buyer is an autonomous agent that can investigate exhaustively, the bottleneck is no longer matching products but acquiring trustworthy, decision-relevant information about them. We envision agentic e-commerce as a micro-transaction market for verified information: buyer agents spend fractions of a cent to progressively unlock seller- and reviewer-supplied data -- service histories, third-party test reports, bills of materials, audited sales and support metrics -- paid for a la carte under a freemium model, with reviewer trust scored reputationally. We sketch the architecture of such a market and argue that it rewards genuine product quality and yields truer competition than ranking-based storefronts. We then translate the vision into concrete NLP problems -- cost-optimal information acquisition, data pricing and negotiation, real-time entity resolution, grounded value exchange, and privacy-preserving persona modelling -- and argue that these, not chat fluency, deserve the field's attention.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，传统商业 NLP 将购物聊天机器人视为推荐器或转化工具，目标是把用户匹配到商品并促成购买；但随着面向 agent 的微支付基础设施（如 x402、AP2）出现，电商中的稀缺资源将发生变化。当买家是可自主、详尽调查的 autonomous agent 时，瓶颈不再是商品匹配，而是获取可信、与决策相关的产品信息。作者设想了一种 agentic e-commerce 信息市场：买方 agent 以几分之一美分的价格，按需解锁由卖家和评测者提供并可验证的数据，如服务历史、第三方测试报告、物料清单、经审计的销售与支持指标等；该市场采用 freemium 模式，并通过声誉机制为评测者建立信任评分。论文勾勒了这一市场架构，认为它能奖励真实产品质量，并比基于排名的 storefront 带来更真实的竞争。最后，作者将愿景转化为一组具体 NLP 问题，包括成本最优的信息获取、数据定价与协商、实时实体消解、基于事实的价值交换，以及隐私保护的人设建模，并主张这些问题比单纯提升聊天流畅度更值得关注。
key_points_zh: 论文提出将 agentic e-commerce 从“推荐与成交”转向“可信信息获取”，认为自主买家 agent 的核心瓶颈是验证决策相关信息，而非商品匹配。
作者设想基于 x402、AP2 等 agent-native micro-payment rails 的微交易市场，买方 agent 可按需购买服务历史、第三方测试、物料清单、审计指标等产品数据。
该市场采用 freemium 与按项付费机制，并通过声誉评分评估 reviewer trust，从而激励高质量、可验证的信息供给。
相比依赖排序和曝光的传统 storefront，该机制被认为能更好奖励真实产品质量，减少排名操控带来的竞争扭曲。
论文将愿景落到 NLP 研究议题：成本最优信息获取、数据定价与协商、实时实体消解、grounded value exchange，以及隐私保护 persona modelling。

llm_assessment.comment: An ambitious position paper that reframes agentic e-commerce around paid access to verified product information.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇有雄心的观点论文，将智能电商重新定义为对经过验证商品信息的付费获取。
